content.json: ## Ops Summary — one table, 4 rows, no scrolling. *Cost Control / Infrastructure / API Health / AI Health, one row each. Cost/Infrastructure/AI Health read the latest `ops_recommendation` run; API Health is live-computed straight from `AppRequests`. `Recent Activity` is a real per-category comment, never fabricated — blank when nothing notable happened. Detail lives on the Cost + Health and AI Control Tower workbooks; this page is the one-glance summary, not a replacement.*

content.json: *`Status` is colour-coded (green=healthy, yellow=warning, red=critical/degraded, blue=no data) — a category with no data never renders green. `Recent Activity` is left blank rather than fabricated when a category's source has nothing notable to say this run.*
